name: Time Is Time
description: Makes the day and night cycle run faster or slower.

keys.label: Announce the module
keys.explain: Announce TimeIsTime. Settings: 0 = off, 1 = on. Default: 1.

keys.label: Enable Time Is Time
keys.explain: Enable TimeIsTime. Settings: 0 = off, 1 = on. Default: 1.

keys.label: Day and night speed
keys.explain: Adjust the number of game days per real day by altering the Realm Timer. 60.0 = 1 game day every 24 minutes, 30.0 = every 48 minutes, 15.0 = every 96 minutes (1.6 hours), 7.5 = every 192 minutes (3.2 hours), 3.75 = every 384 minutes (6.4 hours), 1.875 = every 768 minutes (12.8 hours), 1.0 = every 1440 minutes (24 hours). Default: 1.0 (Blizzlike).

keys.label: Start the game clock at (Unix time)
keys.explain: Start the (client side) game clock at the chosen Epoch (Unix) time at the same time each login. Default: 0 (Local Time).

keys.label: Hour offset
keys.explain: Set together with TimeStart: start the (client side) game clock at the chosen Epoch (Unix) time at the same time each login. Default: 0.0.

notes: The core finds this module by its folder name (the loader defines Addmod_TimeIsTimeScripts), so the clone keeps the author's capitals in modules/mod-TimeIsTime while the id is the lower-case slug.
Restart the worldserver after changing the settings.
